title: Afshan Pattern floral carpet (red ground), 18th century, Khanate Period, Kuba or Baku Region, Azerba
notes: Afshan Pattern floral carpet (red ground), 18th century, Khanate Period, Kuba or Baku Region, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1911. inv. no 177 (774) from the Mosque of Hizir Bey, Isparta. 200 x 393 cm. The principals ornaments are yellow and blue cartouches with blue and yellow rosettes containing small yellow and brown rosettes respectively, decorated with small leaves and dots.
